claims.claim: Added a bounded, versioned, strict in-memory contract for prospective opt-in PRIMARY declarations with immutable identity and provenance bindings.
Separated local iteration, preterminal observations, terminal outcomes and AUTHOR_REPAIR; terminal re-entry and lineage impersonation are rejected.
Factual feedback binds exact proof identities and continuation guards enforce sticky delegation, lease, scope, risk, budgets and progress without strategy or command fields.

Applicability declarations preserve VALID, INVALIDATED and UNKNOWN, separate mandatory proof coverage, no-double-execution invariants and all six base-replay gates without authorizing reuse or execution.
Documented frozen Kernel clauses, compatibility alternatives, Human amendment blockers and explicit STOP/GO gates; Runtime continuation remains NOT_ACTIVATED and KERNEL_AMENDMENT_REQUIRED.
Added synthetic focused tests covering admissible declarations and the specified identity, proof, repetition, authority, lease, scope, budget and terminal counterexamples.
Public validators only parse in-memory data and construct immutable descriptions; focused tests include effect traps and a dependency guard excluding production Runtime, V2 and Kernel integration.
The commit adds only the three authorized files, preserves TASK-326 and active V2 policy, and makes no measurement, publication or VP-01/03/07 completion claim.
